verdicts.reason: A and B look the same. Both stack everything in a narrow skyscraper with the same flaws. The logo is crammed against the top edge, and the centred 'Saturday 21 June' clashes with the left-aligned time/venue line. The three pills are stretched and zig-zag left and right with no grid. The large empty gap above the product card wastes space, and the 'missing asset' placeholder box is cut off at the right edge and sits right under the URL text.
